svg.title: Reuse: Jobs, Steps or a Copy
svg.desc: A reusable workflow is called at job level and runs as its own job on its own runner, a composite action is called at step level and runs inline in the caller's job, and a workflow template is copied once and then diverges.
svg.text: Reuse: Jobs, Steps or a Copy
Reusable workflows replace jobs, composite actions replace steps, templates are copied once.
